body.subtitle: Mind the moat. The gatehouse keeper has been expecting someone, though not necessarily you.

statements.sql: CREATE TABLE world (name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, title TEXT NOT NULL) STRICT

schema_statements: CREATE TABLE _meta ( name TEXT PRIMARY KEY, value TEXT NOT NULL ) WITHOUT ROWID, STRICT
CREATE TABLE _kv ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, size INTEGER NOT NULL, sha256 BLOB NOT NULL, data BLOB ) WITHOUT ROWID, STRICT
CREATE TABLE _head ( id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, version INTEGER NOT NULL ) WITHOUT ROWID, STRICT
CREATE TABLE _turn ( scene TEXT NOT NULL, n INTEGER NOT NULL, role TEXT NOT NULL, content TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (json_valid(content)), PRIMARY KEY (scene, n) ) WITHOUT ROWID, STRICT
